1.web: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
1.asv: The heavens declare the glory of God; And the firmament showeth his handiwork.

2.web: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.
2.asv: Day unto day uttereth speech, And night unto night showeth knowledge.

3.web: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
3.asv: There is no speech nor language; Their voice is not heard.

4.web: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
4.asv: Their line is gone out through all the earth, And their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

5.web: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
5.asv: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, And rejoiceth as a strong man to run his course.

6.web: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends; There is nothing hidden from its heat.
6.asv: His going forth is from the end of the heavens, And his circuit unto the ends of it; And there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

7.web: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s testimony is sure, making wise the simple.
7.asv: The law of Jehovah is perfect, restoring the soul: The testimony of Jehovah is sure, making wise the simple.

8.web: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
8.asv: The precepts of Jehovah are right, rejoicing the heart: The commandment of Jehovah is pure, enlightening the eyes.

9.web: The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
9.asv: The fear of Jehovah is clean, enduring for ever: The ordinances of Jehovah are true, and righteous altogether.

10.web: More to be desired are they than gold, yes, than much fine gold; sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
10.asv: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the droppings of the honeycomb.

11.web: Moreover by them is your servant warned. In keeping them there is great reward.
11.asv: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: In keeping them there is great reward.

12.web: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
12.asv: Who can discern his errors? Clear thou me from hidden faults.

13.web: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
13.asv: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; Let them not have dominion over me: Then shall I be upright, And I shall be clear from great transgression.

14.web: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
14.asv: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in thy sight, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer.
